This tool follows the sequence in Emotion Regulation Handouts 8, 8A, and 9. Begin with the readable [Check the Facts - Handout 8 reference](/learn/emotion-regulation/check-the-facts.html#check-the-facts), then use the original prompts in this tool to reflect without reproducing the source worksheet. [Examples of Emotions That Fit the Facts](/learn/emotion-regulation/examples-emotions-fit-facts.html) keeps Handout 8A available, while the [Handout 9 decision guide](/learn/emotion-regulation/opposite-action.html#opposite-action-decision-path) explains the later branches. [Mindfulness of Current Emotions](/learn/emotion-regulation/observing-describing-emotions.html) remains an available outcome from Handout 22.

The tool does not decide whether an emotion is valid or tell you what you must do. It helps you consider whether the emotion fits the facts and whether its intensity seems proportionate to the current situation.
